subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

The toast __will being ready__ in about 15 minutes.
solution:
The correct answer is **"will be ready"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options,** "will be ready"** will improve the underlined part of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in simple future tense hence, **"will be"** used.
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct alternative.

**The Correct Sentence: **The toast will be ready__ in about 15 minutes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Lets us understand the rules of Simple Future Tense.

 
• The structure for the simple future is **will + [root form of verb].**

 
 
• **Example:** I will learn a new language.
 
• My brothers will sleep till noon if no one wakes them up.
 
• 
 
 
 

 **Will **
 **will be**
 
 

 ** ‘Will’** is used as a modal verb to emphasize on actions/events that will take place in the future.
 **‘Will be’** is used to refer to actions that will be happening in the future, for which the specific time is unknown.
 
 

 It is used as a helping verb to denote the simple future tense. The words, as such, is also used as a noun.
 It is used as a helping verb to depict the future continuous tense.
